content:
The HWPX document was successfully automated by performing XML string substitution and clearing layout cache elements to ensure proper re-rendering.
The script extracted the HWPX ZIP structure and modified 'Contents/section0.xml' using UTF-8 encoding to preserve Korean characters. It specifically targeted and removed '<hp:lineSegArray>' elements within modified paragraph tags to force Hancom Office to recalculate text layout. The final document was re-packaged using 'zipfile' with 'ZIP_DEFLATED' to maintain file integrity.
